note: Both sets capture the same core baseline specifications (HabEx 4 m/4 instruments, LUVOIR-A 15 m on-axis/4, LUVOIR-B 8 m off-axis/3, Lynx 3 m grazing-incidence mirror with 10 m focal length, Origins 5.9 m/3) with values correctly bound and quotes traceable to the text. Set A additionally preserves the needed condition that the 52 m starshade is on a separate spacecraft flying in formation, which Set B drops entirely from its starshade claim. Set A's downside is redundancy (duplicate claims for HabEx instrument count, Lynx diameter, and starshade diameter) and both sets share the same mild 'aperture' reinterpretation of '4 m telescope' wording; both also omit Lynx's three science instruments. On balance A is the more faithful and complete extraction despite its extra trivial claims.
